title: Half Turns and Quarter Turns, Clockwise and Counterclockwise
seo_title: Grade 1 Half and Quarter Turns Worksheets with Answers (MATATAG Math 1)
standard_text: Identify the position of objects moved in half turn or in quarter turn, in clockwise or in counter-clockwise direction.
meta_desc: Free Grade 1 turns worksheets for the DepEd MATATAG curriculum: half turns and quarter turns, clockwise and counterclockwise, and which way you face. 100 questions with pictures and answers.
key_sub: Clockwise: the way clock hands move.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • A quarter turn is one corner of a square. A half turn is two quarter turns: you face the opposite way.
  • Clockwise is the way the hands of a clock move. Counterclockwise is the other way.
  • Facing the board, a quarter turn clockwise makes you face right. A half turn makes you face the back.

Examples

Example

An arrow points up. A quarter turn clockwise.

up → right

Answer: it points right

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Clockwise or counterclockwise?Think of a clock's hands.
Half or quarter?A half turn faces the opposite way.
Wrong startBegin from the way you face now.

faq.q: What does MATATAG Math 1 ask about turns?
faq.a: Identify the position of objects moved in half turn or in quarter turn, in clockwise or in counter-clockwise direction.

faq.q: How many quarter turns make a half turn?
Do a half turn clockwise and counterclockwise end the same?

faq.a: Stand up, face the board and turn.

items.q: What turn does the arrow show? It starts at the dashed line.
items.e: The arrow goes a quarter of the way round. That is a quarter turn.

items.q: What turn does the arrow show? It starts at the dashed line.
items.e: The arrow goes halfway round. The end line points the opposite way. That is a half turn.

items.e: The arrow goes halfway round. The end line points the opposite way. That is a half turn.

items.q: How many quarter turns make a half turn?
items.e: A quarter and another quarter make a half. So 2 quarter turns make a half turn.

items.q: Which turn makes you face the opposite way?
items.e: A half turn goes halfway round. You face the opposite way.

items.q: Which is the smallest turn?
items.e: A quarter turn is only 1 quarter of the way round. It is the smallest.

items.q: Joshua makes a quarter turn. Then he makes another quarter turn the same way. What turn is that altogether?
items.e: 1 quarter + 1 quarter = 2 quarters. That is a half turn.

items.e: The end line points the opposite way to the dashed line. The arrow goes halfway round: a half turn.

items.q: The minute hand turns from the dashed line to where it is now. Which turn does it make?
items.e: From 12 to 3 is a quarter of the way round, the same way clocks go: clockwise.

items.q: The minute hand turns from the dashed line to where it is now. Which turn does it make?
items.e: From 12 to 6 is halfway round, the same way clocks go: clockwise.

items.q: The minute hand turns from the dashed line to where it is now. Which turn does it make?
items.e: From 12 back to 9 is a quarter of the way round, the opposite way to clocks: counterclockwise.

items.q: The minute hand turns from the dashed line to where it is now. Which turn does it make?
items.e: From 3 back to 9 is halfway round, the opposite way to clocks: counterclockwise.

items.q: Which way do the hands on a clock turn?
items.e: Clock hands always turn the same way. That way is called clockwise.

items.q: What does counterclockwise mean?
c: the same way as clock hands
the opposite way to clock hands
items.e: Counterclockwise is the opposite way to the way clock hands go.

items.q: Jose says this arrow turns clockwise. Is he right?
c: No, it is a half turn
items.e: Clock hands go from 12 to 3: to the right at the top. This arrow goes to the left at the top. It is counterclockwise.

items.q: Sheila makes a quarter turn clockwise. Then she makes a quarter turn counterclockwise. Which way does she face now?
c: a quarter turn clockwise from the start
a quarter turn counterclockwise from the start
the same way as at the start
items.e: The second turn goes back the other way by the same amount. So she faces the same way as at the start.

items.q: Nico makes a half turn clockwise. His friend makes a half turn counterclockwise. They both started facing the board. What is true now?
c: They both face away from the board
items.e: A half turn either way makes you face the opposite way. So they both face away from the board.

items.q: Trisha makes a quarter turn clockwise. Then she makes another quarter turn clockwise. How far has she turned?
items.e: 1 quarter + 1 quarter = a half. Both turns were clockwise, so it is a half turn clockwise.

items.q: Bianca says this arrow turns clockwise. Is she right?
c: No, it is a half turn
items.e: Clock hands go from 12 to 3: to the right at the top. This arrow goes to the left at the top. It is counterclockwise.

items.q: Paolo makes a quarter turn clockwise. Then he makes a quarter turn counterclockwise. Which way does he face now?
c: a quarter turn clockwise from the start
the same way as at the start
a quarter turn counterclockwise from the start
items.e: The second turn goes back the other way by the same amount. So he faces the same way as at the start.

items.q: Ivan makes a half turn clockwise. His friend makes a half turn counterclockwise. They both started facing the board. What is true now?
c: They both face away from the board
items.e: A half turn either way makes you face the opposite way. So they both face away from the board.

items.q: Jericho makes a quarter turn clockwise. Then he makes another quarter turn clockwise. How far has he turned?
items.e: 1 quarter + 1 quarter = a half. Both turns were clockwise, so it is a half turn clockwise.

items.q: Bianca faces the board. She makes a quarter turn clockwise. What does she face now?
items.e: Go the way clock hands go, one quarter at a time: board, then window.

items.q: Bryan faces the swings. He makes a quarter turn clockwise. What does he face now?
items.e: Go the way clock hands go, one quarter at a time: swings, then canteen.

items.q: Mae faces the house. She makes a half turn. What does she face now?
items.e: A half turn makes you face the opposite way. The gate is opposite the house.

items.q: Andrea faces the door. She makes a quarter turn counterclockwise. What does she face now?
items.e: Go the opposite way to clock hands, one quarter at a time: door, then window.

items.q: Rose faces the sandbox. She makes a quarter turn clockwise. What does she face now?
items.e: Go the way clock hands go, one quarter at a time: sandbox, then slide.

items.q: Emmanuel faces the window. He makes a quarter turn counterclockwise. What does he face now?
items.e: Go the opposite way to clock hands, one quarter at a time: window, then board.

items.q: Sheila faces the shed. She makes a half turn. What does she face now?
items.e: A half turn makes you face the opposite way. The tree is opposite the shed.

items.q: The hand points to 12. It makes a quarter turn clockwise. Where does it point now?
items.e: Go clockwise, a quarter at a time: 12, then 3.

items.q: The hand points to 3. It makes a quarter turn clockwise. Where does it point now?
items.e: Go clockwise, a quarter at a time: 3, then 6.

items.q: The hand points to 6. It makes a half turn clockwise. Where does it point now?
items.e: Go clockwise, a quarter at a time: 6, then 9, then 12.

items.q: An arrow points up. It makes a quarter turn clockwise. Which picture shows it now?
items.e: Picture B. A quarter turn clockwise turns the arrow from up to the right.

items.q: An arrow points up. It makes a half turn. Which picture shows it now?
items.e: Picture C. A half turn makes the arrow point the opposite way: down.

items.q: An arrow points up. It makes a quarter turn counterclockwise. Which picture shows it now?
items.e: Picture D. A quarter turn counterclockwise turns the arrow from up to the left.

items.q: Mark faces the door. He makes a half turn. He says he faces the window. Is he right?
items.e: The window is only a quarter turn away. A half turn makes you face the opposite way. The board is opposite the door.

items.q: Turn the start shape a quarter turn clockwise. Which picture shows it?
items.e: Picture A. The top of the shape turns to the right, the way clock hands go. A flipped shape is not a turn.

items.q: Turn the start shape a half turn. Which picture shows it?
items.e: Picture B. After a half turn the shape is upside down. The top is now at the bottom. A flipped shape is not a turn.

items.q: Turn the start shape a quarter turn counterclockwise. Which picture shows it?
items.e: Picture C. The top of the shape turns to the left, the opposite way to clock hands. A flipped shape is not a turn.

items.q: Turn the start shape a half turn. Which picture shows it?
items.e: Picture D. After a half turn the shape is upside down. The top is now at the bottom. A flipped shape is not a turn.

items.e: Picture B. The top of the shape turns to the right, the way clock hands go. A flipped shape is not a turn.

items.e: Picture C. The top of the shape turns to the left, the opposite way to clock hands. A flipped shape is not a turn.

items.q: What turn moves the shape from before to after?
items.e: The top of the flag pole turns to the right, the way clock hands go: a quarter turn clockwise.

items.q: What turn moves the shape from before to after?
items.e: The top of the shape turns to the left, the opposite way to clock hands: a quarter turn counterclockwise.

items.q: What turn moves the shape from before to after?
items.e: The shape is upside down now. That is a half turn.

items.q: What turn moves the shape from before to after?
items.e: The arrow pointed up. Now it points right. That is a quarter turn clockwise.

items.q: What turn moves the shape from before to after?
items.e: The flag pole pointed up. Now it points left. That is a quarter turn counterclockwise.

items.q: Which capital letter looks the same after a half turn?
items.e: Turn the page upside down. N still looks like N. L, F and E do not.

items.q: When you turn a shape, what changes?
items.e: Turning does not change the shape or its size. Only the way it faces changes.

items.q: A square makes a quarter turn. What does it look like now?
items.e: All the sides of a square are the same. After a quarter turn it looks just the same.

items.q: Which shape looks different after a quarter turn?
items.e: A long rectangle that lies flat stands up tall after a quarter turn. The others look the same.

items.q: A flag pole points up. Rodel turns the flag a quarter turn clockwise. He says the pole points left now. Is he right?
items.e: Clockwise is the way clock hands go. From 12 they go to 3, on the right. So the pole points right.

items.q: A triangle has 3 corners. It makes a half turn. How many corners does it have now?
items.e: Turning a shape does not change it. It still has 3 corners.

items.q: Jericho turns a puzzle piece a half turn. Then he turns it another half turn. What does it look like now?
c: the same as at the start
items.e: A half turn and another half turn make a full turn. The piece is back the way it started.

items.q: A flag pole points up. Trisha turns the flag a quarter turn clockwise. She says the pole points left now. Is she right?
items.e: Clockwise is the way clock hands go. From 12 they go to 3, on the right. So the pole points right.

items.q: Bryan turns a puzzle piece a half turn. Then he turns it another half turn. What does it look like now?
c: the same as at the start
items.e: A half turn and another half turn make a full turn. The piece is back the way it started.

items.q: It was 4 o’clock. The minute hand made this turn. What time is it now?
items.e: A quarter turn of the minute hand is 15 minutes. 15 minutes after 4 o’clock is quarter past 4.

items.q: It was 7 o’clock. The minute hand made this turn. What time is it now?
items.e: A half turn of the minute hand is 30 minutes. 30 minutes after 7 o’clock is half past 7.

items.q: From 2 o’clock to half past 2, what turn does the minute hand make?
items.e: The minute hand goes from 12 to 6. That is halfway round: a half turn.

items.q: Jericho turns the garden tap a quarter turn. Then he turns it another quarter turn the same way. How far has the tap turned?
items.e: 1 quarter + 1 quarter = 2 quarters. That is a half turn.

items.q: You turn a jar lid counterclockwise to open it. Which way do you turn it to close it?
items.e: Closing is the opposite of opening. The opposite of counterclockwise is clockwise.

items.q: Sheila puts a key in the front door lock. She turns it a half turn. How does the key look now?
items.e: A half turn turns the key upside down. A quarter turn would leave it on its side.

items.q: Ella rides her skateboard to the end of the path. She does a half turn. Which way does she go now?
items.e: A half turn makes you face the opposite way. So she rides back the way she came.

items.q: Camille gets on the Ferris wheel at the bottom. The wheel makes a half turn. Where is her seat now?
items.e: A half turn goes halfway around the wheel. The bottom goes to the top.

items.q: At lunch, Jose faces the canteen. He makes a quarter turn clockwise. What does he face now?
items.e: Go the way clock hands go: canteen, then sandbox.

items.q: Patricia faces the sea. She turns to face the car park behind her. What turn is that?
items.e: The car park is opposite the sea. Turning to face the opposite way is a half turn.

items.q: Andrea turns a round door knob a quarter turn clockwise. She lets go and it turns back. How does it turn back?
items.e: It goes back the same amount the other way. The other way to clockwise is counterclockwise.
